row.title: SEED-DEPLOY-1: seeds deploy over the OIDC route; a merged step in a skipped job proves nothing
row.body: Lesson: the first seed deploy was hooked into deploy-workers, whose job is skipped on the current account, so merging it deployed nothing; verified by listing the account's Workers and finding no seed Worker. Decision: seeds deploy through deploy-oidc.mjs to the site deployer, with one OIDC-gated database call limited to ultrastable-seed-<slug> names. Probe: python3 -m foundation seedadmit --live exits 0 only when each seed's /health answers; node site/seedd1.test.mjs proves the scope.
